name: Alpenresort Schwarz
beschreibung: The Alpenresort Schwarz in Mieming, Tirol, is located on the Mieminger Plateau with a view of the mountain panorama. The accommodation offers rooms and suites, some of which have a balcony. The wellness area includes an indoor pool, saunas, and relaxation rooms. The restaurant uses seasonal and regional products. Guests use the hotel as a base for hikes, bike tours, and winter sports. The property is designed for quiet relaxation and also offers activities for children. Families and couples alike find suitable conditions. Thanks to its location, excursions to Innsbruck or into the Ötztal are possible.
